# ArtemisKit

> ArtemisKit is an open-source AI evaluation and assurance toolkit by Vorbtech Innovative Solutions. It provides scenario-based testing and inspectable evidence.

The CLI requires Bun. A result is scoped to the tested scenario and does not certify safety or compliance.

## Start here

- [Website](https://www.artemiskit.dev/): Product overview and use cases.
- [Documentation](https://www.artemiskit.dev/docs/): Concepts, CLI, SDK and workflows.
- [Getting started](https://www.artemiskit.dev/docs/getting-started/): Install the CLI and run a first evaluation.
- [Source code](https://github.com/code-sensei/artemiskit): Repository, license and examples.
